leak: Long-dated box locks capital until expiry

decision_record.transfer: A box spread's edge (width - executable debit) is a locked payout received only at expiry; the payer is time — the same 0.30/share edge at 119 DTE earns ~1/8 the annualized return of the 14-DTE box and locks the $10k slice meanwhile.
decision_record.comparison: Control: take largest edge over all expiries >=7 DTE. Treatment: refuse entry packages expiring >60 DTE; exits never filtered.
decision_record.mechanism: parity_decision scans every expiry and picks max per-share edge with no term weighting, so a far expiry with a marginally larger edge wins and traps the capital.
decision_record.calculation: Fixture: identical prices at exp 2027-02-19 (119 DTE) -> 0 legs ON, 4 OFF; exp 2026-11-06 (14 DTE) still enters 4 ON. Edge threshold (0.30) unchanged.
decision_record.experiment: Adapter filter filter_parity_max_dte(max_dte=60) on package_id expiry; paired on extra['enh2_paired']; blockers fail-first proven.
